### 🎮 Hardware & Connection Quality
- **Bluetooth Connection:**

### 🕹️ Controller Mode Verification
Which modes did you test?
- [ ] **Mode 1: Desktop Mouse** (Analog stick cursor, Left/Right clicks, scrolling)
- [ ] **Mode 2: Universal Media Remote** (Play/pause, side-rail volume, rewind/fast-forward)
- [ ] **Mode 3: Presentation Clicker** (Slide forward, slide back, blank screen)
- [ ] **Mode 4: Custom / Experimental Mode**
